scope: Extraction and matching of Siquijor Province education facilities from the user-supplied HOTOSM / OpenStreetMap Philippines GeoJSON archive (hotosm_phl_education_facilities_osm_geojson.zip).

sourceArchive.publisher: OpenStreetMap contributors via HOTOSM / HDX oex

extract.filter: adm2_pcode == PH07061 (adm2_name == Siquijor), 100% agreement with Siquijor Island bounding box [123.43, 9.05, 123.76, 9.34]

preservedDiscrepanciesAndCaveats: OpenStreetMap data is volunteer-mapped and not exhaustive; 7 small private schools/learning centers in data/derived/schools.json are not named in this OSM snapshot, and community-mapped day care centers appear mainly in Enrique Villanueva (13) and Siquijor (1).

HOTOSM attaches OCHA administrative polygons (adm1_name='Region VII (Central Visayas)' and coarse ADM3/ADM4 polygons) that place 9 border-area schools under neighbouring municipalities compared to DepEd school records (Candigum ES, New Bataan ES, Pisong B ES, Bogo IS, Cantugbas ES/IS, Cadoldolan ES, Ytaya ES, Tambisan ES, Tambisan NHS). DepEd municipal assignments are retained as primary for the school directory; OSM adm3_name is preserved separately.

OSM node/8493963917 spells Carmelite College of Siquijor, Inc. as 'Carmelite Collegr of Siquijor, Inc.' and way/1101369641 uses 'Cantugbas Elementary School' where DepEd lists 'Cantugbas Integrated School'; original OSM names are preserved verbatim in osmName.

Siquijor State College has two additional mapped Lazi campus features in OSM (way/715268787 and way/710670379), and Lazi Technical Institute (way/730978913) is tagged amenity=college in OSM; it is kept under additional community-mapped facilities rather than altering the UniFAST/CHED four-college directory.
